description: Rename an existing contact group. Use contact_group_get first to retrieve the current etag. System groups (e.g. "My Contacts", "Starred") cannot be renamed.

etag.description: The etag from the contact group (required to prevent conflicts)

name.description: New name for the contact group

resourceName.description: The resource name of the contact group to update (e.g., "contactGroups/1234")

name: contact_group_update
title: Update contact group
